messages:
frank: spinning up a safety gate for bridge-head-calib-v2 (int4) on 0.7% traffic. focus: rerank_nDCG@20, structured exact-match, and answer hallucination. immediate rollback rules for any hallucination +0.6% abs or nDCG drop >1.7% rel over 5m.

emma: baseline comparison = bridge-head-v1 fp16-prod, right?

frank: correct. v1-fp16 is baseline. added watch slices: 'kb_long', 'forms_nested', 'rerank_mid'.

li: can we enable pairwise-concordance vs fp16 for critical fields and have eval-bot attach diffs inline when concordance <95%?

frank: yes. enabling concordance check and sample_diffs_on_trigger. gate snippet:

```
gate_id: bridgehead-calib-safety-4512
canary_fraction: 0.007
watch_slices: ["kb_long","forms_nested","rerank_mid"]
metrics:
  - name: hallucination_rate
    threshold_abs: 0.6% 
    window_s: 300
    action: immediate_rollback_if_concordance<95%
  - name: rerank_ndcg20
    threshold_rel: -1.7%
    window_s: 300
    action: immediate_rollback
  - name: structured_exact
    threshold_abs: -1.0%
    window_s: 300
    action: rollback_after_repeat
report_interval_s: 180
autofallback_cooldown_s: 3600
notify: ["#eng-ml","#eng-oncall"]
```

eval-bot: smoke-run started t=0. cohorts: kb_long(n=220), forms_nested(n=260), rerank_mid(n=240). will post every 3m.

emma: bump kb_long to 400 for next interval to reduce noise on long contexts. also pin 'alpha-corp' to fp16.

frank: done  bumped sample and pinned alpha-corp.

eval-bot: t+3m report: rerank_ndcg20 delta = -0.9% (ok), structured_exact delta = -0.5% (ok), hallucination_rate +0.2% (ok). no triggers.

li: note: last int4 bridge run had subtle tokenization shifts for nested forms that only show up after ~7m. keep an eye on forms_nested tail.

frank: acknowledged. raising forms_nested sample to 600 for remainder of run.

eval-bot: t+9m report: forms_nested concordance = 94.6% (<95%), hallucination_rate delta = +0.7% -> exceeds 0.6% threshold. concordance guard tripped. initiating immediate rollback and posting sample diffs. scaling canary fraction to 0.0 and alerting #eng-oncall.

frank: ack. freezing promos and collecting diffs. please do not re-run promotions until triage.

emma: can you paste 3 representative diffs inline? short snippets suffice.

frank: pasted 3 trimmed diffs: 
- id F-120: fp16 structured: "{address: \"Unit 5, 140 Rose St\"}" -> int4: "{address: \"Unit 5, 140 Rose\"}" (missing token)
- id F-141: fp16: phone normalized -> int4: country code duplicated (+1+1)
- id F-155: fp16: ranked answer A first -> int4: answer B promoted (score inversion)

li: looks like head-calibration scaling plus tokenizer boundary rounding. action items: 1) revert head-calib patch in int4 build 2) run offline sim on forms_nested n=10k with token-edit logging 3) add token-boundary unit test to CI and require passing before next canary.

frank: opening tickets ML-6720/6721/6722 and scheduling 30m triage. adding guard: block auto-promote for int4 bridge variants for 24h after hallucination-triggered rollback.

ops-bot: SRE notified. if rollback recurs within 30m, page on-call.

frank: summary: canary rolled back due to forms_nested concordance 94.6% and hallucination +0.7% -> immediate rollback applied. samples captured, VIP pinned, follow-ups assigned. scheduling postmortem after triage. thanks team :pray:
